name: Laila
source:
A serious and cool magic swordsman type high elf. 
Elves have no genders as only female elves exists, so she denies her own feminine features and beauty as a wowan to dedicate herself to the path of the warrior.
She is trusted as a guardian of the forest, and is given a divine sword by the Princess Maiden.
